description.p1: Code 282· Set on a low rise above the lagoon, Bungalow 1 is a single-level pavilion of local hardwoods, with a deep timber deck, a salt-water plunge pool, and louvered walls that fold back to the trade winds.
description.p2: Code 283· Inside, a king bed faces the sea through a wall of glass; a freestanding stone tub looks the same direction. Mornings begin with the sun coming up through the palms; evenings end with the lagoon's soft phosphorescence under the stars.
description.p3: Code 284· Bungalow 1 includes a dedicated butler, twice-daily housekeeping, and a private outrigger berth at the resort dock for guests who'd like to take to the water on their own schedule.

description.title: Code 295· A two-level pavilion above the lagoon.
description.p1: Code 296· Bungalow 2 is a two-level hardwood pavilion set into the slope above the lagoon. description.p2: Code 297· A chef's table on the deck seats six and is paired with a kitchen for in-residence dining; on most evenings the resort's executive chef will cook for guests on request, with a single-day notice. The view shifts every half hour from the trade-wind palms to the open sea.
description.p3: Code 298· Bungalow 2 includes a dedicated butler, twice-daily housekeeping, and an electric buggy for the run down to the beach club. Children are welcome; the second bedroom converts to twin beds on request.

hero.title: Code 318· On the Black Sea coast
hero.sub: Code 319· A small port town on Bulgaria's southern Black Sea coast, framed by the Strandzha pine forest and a long ribbon of quiet beaches.

guide.lede: Code 321· Tsarevo sits at the southern end of the Bulgarian Black Sea coast, where the Strandzha National Park's pine ridges run all the way down to the water.
guide.intro_para1: Code 322· It's an old fishing port that grew slowly — small harbour, a single ridge, a tight grid of low-rise streets — and the seasonality is gentle. The beaches stretch in both directions: Veleka and Sinemorets to the south, the sweep of Tsarevo bay to the north, and a string of unnamed coves in between.
guide.intro_para2: Code 323· It's reachable by car in a little over an hour from Burgas Airport (BOJ, ~85 km) and by a long drive from Sofia (SOF, ~410 km). Most guests fly into BOJ; the route hugs the coast from Burgas south, with the sea on the left almost all the way down.

beach.img_alt: A wide stretch of soft sand running into the Black Sea — characteristic of the long, quiet beaches around Tsarevo
beach.title: Code 325· Beaches and coves
beach.body: Code 326· Long open beaches give way to small, half-hidden coves the further south you walk. Veleka, just down the coast, is one of the cleanest river-mouth beaches in the country; the smaller bays north of town are reachable only on foot or by water and rarely crowded, even in August.

food.img_alt: An aerial view of clear turquoise water meeting a palm-fringed white sand beach
food.title: Code 328· Restaurants and local food
food.body: Code 329· Most of what's good is within walking distance of the harbour: fresh Black Sea catch, mussels and rapana from the bay, and a handful of small family kitchens that serve mezze under grapevines. A few inland wineries in the Strandzha foothills run tasting days through the warm months.

hiking.img_alt: A warm sunrise over a calm sea, with soft pink and gold light on the shoreline
hiking.title: Code 331· Hiking and nature
hiking.body: Code 332· Strandzha National Park — the largest protected area in Bulgaria — begins at the edge of town and runs inland for tens of kilometres. Marked trails follow the river valleys; the migratory bird routes overhead in spring and autumn are reason enough for a long walk, even if you don't normally count yourself a birder.

villages.img_alt: A jagged mountain peak rising above a sea of clouds at sunset, washed in pink and gold light
villages.title: Code 334· Nearby villages and culture
villages.body: Code 335· Sinemorets and Ahtopol are short drives down the coast, each with its own character — Sinemorets quieter and built around its river-mouth beach, Ahtopol with a working harbour and a small old town on a headland. Inland, Strandzha villages keep older traditions alive, including the fire-dancing rituals that the region is known for.

head.title: Code 424· Privacy Policy
head.lede: Code 426· This page explains what personal data Vayana Bungalows collects, why we collect it, how long we keep it, and what rights you have over it under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Bulgarian data-protection law.

updated.title: Code 427· 1. Last updated

who.title: Code 430· 2. Who we are
who.para1: Code 431· We are {brand}, operated by Vayana di Mare, a Bulgarian hospitality business operating under licence number {license}.
who.para2_before: Code 432· Our registered location is {address_street}, {address_country}. For any privacy-related question you can reach us by email at
who.para3: Code 434· For the purposes of GDPR, we are the data controller for any personal data submitted through this website.

collect.title: Code 435· 3. What data we collect
collect.intro: Code 436· We only collect personal data that you actively provide to us, plus a small amount of technical data that our anti-spam tools need to operate. We do not run any analytics, advertising, or behavioural-tracking tools on this site.
collect.form_title: Code 437· 3.1 Data you give us through the enquiry form
collect.form_intro_after: Code 439· collects the following fields. All are submitted only when you choose to submit the form:
collect.form_field_dates: Code 443· Preferred check-in and check-out dates
collect.form_field_guests: Code 444· Number of guests (adults, children, infants)
collect.form_field_message: Code 445· A free-text message describing your enquiry
collect.form_field_consent: Code 446· A consent checkbox confirming you agree to be contacted (this is logged together with the submission, so we have a record of your consent — see §4)
collect.form_flow: Code 447· When you submit the form, your data is sent to a Cloudflare Worker running on Cloudflare's global edge network, which validates the submission and appends a row to a Google Sheet held in Google Workspace (EU region). See §6 Who we share data with and §7 Where data is stored for the processors involved, and §8 How long we keep data for the retention period.
collect.captcha_title: Code 448· 3.2 Technical data via Cloudflare Turnstile (anti-spam)
collect.captcha_intro: Code 449· The enquiry form is protected against bots by Cloudflare Turnstile in managed mode. When you submit the form, Turnstile collects, on Cloudflare's behalf:
collect.captcha_ip_before: Code 450· Your IP address — sent by your browser directly to Cloudflare's
collect.captcha_ip_after: Code 451· endpoint together with the challenge token
collect.captcha_browser: Code 452· Browser characteristics (user agent, screen size, plug-in list)
collect.captcha_signals: Code 453· Interaction signals on the form page (mouse / keyboard movement timing)
collect.captcha_note_before: Code 454· The captcha data above does not pass through our servers in clear form — it goes directly from your browser to Cloudflare, which returns only a success / failure result to our Worker. Our Worker logs only a salted SHA-256 hash of your IP address (not the raw address) into the Google Sheet, as
collect.captcha_note_after: Code 455· , so we can correlate repeat enquiries without storing identifying data. We rotate the salt periodically; rotation makes earlier hashes uncorrelatable with any future submission, which is the intended privacy property.
collect.maps_title: Code 456· 3.3 Cookies and tracking from embedded Google Maps
collect.maps_body: Code 457· The map on the homepage and on Contacts / Destination embeds a Google Maps iframe. When the page loads the iframe, Google may set cookies in your browser and receive your IP address — this happens automatically as soon as the page is rendered, whether or not you interact with the map. We have no control over what Google collects in that context — please see Google's own privacy policy.
collect.newsletter_body: Code 459· The newsletter signup form on the homepage accepts an email address into an input field but, in version 1, that email is not stored anywhere and is not transmitted off your device — submitting the form opens a "thank you" modal and discards what you typed. When a real email-service-provider integration ships, this section will be updated in the same release to list the provider and what they receive.

why.title: Code 460· 4. Why we collect it (legal basis)
why.consent: Code 461· Your consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)). The enquiry form processes your data on the basis of the consent you give by ticking the checkbox above the submit button. You can withdraw that consent at any time — see §9.
why.legitimate: Code 462· Our legitimate interest (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)). The captcha service that runs alongside the form processes the technical data listed in §3.2 to protect our site from automated spam submissions. We have weighed this interest against your rights and consider it proportionate, since the data captured is the minimum required to score a request as bot-or-human.

use.title: Code 463· 5. How we use it
use.intro: Code 464· We use the data you give us solely to:
use.item_reply: Code 465· Reply to your enquiry with a tailored proposal
use.item_record: Code 466· Hold a record of your stated preferences in case you reply later in the same thread
use.item_spam: Code 467· Detect and block spam submissions (captcha)
use.outro: Code 468· We do not use enquiry data for marketing. We do not share it with advertising networks. We do not run any automated decision-making or profiling on it.

third.title: Code 469· 6. Third parties
third.intro: Code 470· When you use this site, the following third parties may process some of your personal data on our behalf:
third.google: Code 471· Google LLC — for the embedded Google Maps iframe (§3.3) and for storing enquiry submissions in a Google Sheet held in Google Workspace (EU region, §7). Google's processing is governed by its own privacy policy and the Google Workspace Data Processing Addendum.
third.cloudflare: Code 472· Cloudflare, Inc. — for hosting the Cloudflare Worker that accepts your enquiry submission (§3.1) and for the Cloudflare Turnstile anti-spam check that runs before submission (§3.2). Cloudflare's processing is governed by its own privacy policy and its customer Data Processing Addendum.
third.github: Code 473· GitHub, Inc. — this website is served as a static site through GitHub Pages. GitHub receives your IP address and basic request metadata in the course of serving the page. GitHub's processing is governed by its own privacy statement.

storage.title: Code 474· 7. Where data is stored
storage.intro: Code 475· The static website itself contains no stored personal data. When you submit the enquiry form:
storage.item_edge: Code 476· Your submission passes through Cloudflare's globally distributed edge network — the Worker that processes it runs on Cloudflare's edge close to your location, then writes only to the destinations below.
storage.item_sheet: Code 477· The validated submission is appended as a row to a Google Sheet held in Google Workspace, with the storage region set to the European Union.
storage.item_hash_before: Code 478· Only a salted SHA-256 hash of your IP address is written to the sheet (in the
storage.item_hash_after: Code 479· column) — the raw IP is never stored at rest on our side.
storage.encryption: Code 480· In-flight TLS encryption is provided by Cloudflare (between your browser and the Worker) and by Google (between the Worker and the Sheets API). At-rest encryption on Google Workspace is provided by Google.

retention.title: Code 481· 8. How long we keep it
retention.para1: Code 482· We keep enquiry data for the minimum time necessary to respond to you and follow up. Our current target is to delete enquiry records 12 months after the last interaction in that thread.
retention.para2: Code 483· If your enquiry becomes a booking, the booking-related data is retained under our booking terms (not this policy). If your enquiry does not become a booking, the 12-month window applies.
retention.para3: Code 484· The "12 months" figure is provisional and will be confirmed before launch.

rights.title: Code 485· 9. Your rights
rights.intro_before: Code 486· Under GDPR, you have the following rights over the data we hold about you. To exercise any of them, email us at
rights.intro_after: Code 487· and we will respond within one calendar month.
rights.access: Code 488· Access (Art. 15) — ask us for a copy of what we hold about you.
rights.rectification: Code 489· Rectification (Art. 16) — ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
rights.erasure: Code 490· Erasure (Art. 17) — ask us to delete your data, where one of the grounds in Art. 17(1) applies.
rights.restriction: Code 491· Restriction (Art. 18) — ask us to pause processing while we investigate a dispute.
rights.portability: Code 492· Portability (Art. 20) — ask us to send you (or another controller) a machine-readable copy.
rights.object: Code 493· Object (Art. 21) — object to processing carried out on the basis of legitimate interest (§4).
rights.withdraw: Code 494· Withdraw consent (Art. 7(3)) — withdraw the consent you gave on the enquiry form at any time, by emailing us. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of any processing carried out before the withdrawal.
rights.complaint: Code 495· You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP) if you believe we have mishandled your data.

cookies.title: Code 496· 10. Cookies
cookies.intro: Code 497· We do not set any first-party cookies on this site. Cookies are only set by embedded third-party content:
cookies.maps: Code 498· Google Maps — sets cookies and receives your IP address when the embedded map iframe loads on the homepage, the Contacts page, and the Destination page; see Google's own cookie disclosures
cookies.turnstile_before: Code 499· Cloudflare Turnstile — in managed mode, Turnstile does not set cookies for most visitors. If a visitor is challenged for pre-clearance (rare; happens for traffic that looks abusive), Cloudflare may set a
cookies.turnstile_after: Code 500· cookie scoped to the Turnstile challenge domain. See Cloudflare's cookie reference.
cookies.outro: Code 501· We do not run any analytics, advertising, or behavioural-tracking cookies. If that changes — for example if we add a newsletter analytics tool — we will add a cookie banner before doing so and update this section.

contact.title: Code 502· 11. How to contact us about data
contact.intro: Code 503· For anything related to your data — access requests, corrections, deletions, complaints, or just questions about this policy — please email us:
contact.outro: Code 507· We aim to acknowledge data-related emails within five working days, and to substantively reply within one calendar month, as GDPR requires.

changes.title: Code 508· 12. Changes to this policy
changes.para1: Code 509· We may update this policy from time to time — for example when we add a new third-party service, change our retention schedule, or in response to a regulatory update. Whenever we update it, we change the "last updated" date at the top.
changes.para2: Code 510· For material changes (anything that affects what we collect, why we collect it, or how long we keep it), we will additionally announce the change on the homepage for a reasonable period of time so that returning visitors notice.
